tools.name: powershell
tools.targetPath: $root = Join-Path $env:TEMP "taskforge-debug-$([guid]::NewGuid())"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $root | Out-Null; try { $csv1 = Join-Path $root 'one.csv'; $csv2 = Join-Path $root 'two.csv'; $data = Join-Path $root 'tasks.json'; "Title,Status`nOne,pending`nTwo,completed" | Set-Content $csv1; "Title`nThree" | Set-Content $csv2; & $PSHOME/pwsh -NoProfile -File ./src/TaskForge.ps1 import-csv --path $csv1 --data-file $data --json | Out-Null; $output = @(& $PSHOME/pwsh -NoProfile -File ./src/TaskForge.ps1 import-csv --path $csv2 --data-file $data 2>&1); $joined = $output -join "`n"; [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE; Lines = $output.Count; Text = $joined; ImportMatches = ([regex]::Matches($joined, 'IMPORT')).Count } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 } finally { Remove-Item $root -Recurse -Force }
